text.control: Can be commanded by Orianna to perform certain actions when she casts Command: Attack, Command: Dissonance, Command: Protect, or Command: Shockwave.
text.spelleffects: The Ball, when hitting enemies, applies spell effects as area damage.
text.abilities:
;Escort
The Ball is attached to Orianna at all times, but can be commanded to attach to other units through Command: Protect.

;Clockwork Affinity
The Ball, while not attached to a unit, can be picked up by Orianna when she moves near it. If Orianna moves too far away from The Ball, it snaps back and attaches to her instantly.

;Collision Immunity
The Ball ignores all terrain collision.

=== General ===
* An arrow will appear near Orianna whenever The Ball is not attached to her, pointing towards its location.
** The arrow will change colors depending on how far away The Ball and Orianna are from each other.
*** If they are relatively near each other, the arrow is blue.
*** If they are close to being outside of range of each other, the arrow is yellow (lime in colorblind mode).
**** If it is very close, the arrow is red.

==Trivia==

* ''Orianna'' is a widespread {{w|Romance languages|Romance}} name, merged from two Latin roots with feminine suffix ''-na'':
** ''Orior'' "I rise"; cf. {{w|Orient|Orientalis}}, referring the rising sun.
** ''Aurum'' "{{w|gold}}"; which she shares with {{ci|Aurelion Sol}}.
* Orianna was the last champion priced lower than {{IP|6300}} on release.
* {{ai|Clockwork Winding|Orianna}} is named after and references {{w|Clockwork|the eponymous gear mechanism}}.
* Orianna's icon during her 'Champion Spotlight' was a [http://www.walfas.org/ walfas-styled face.]
* Multiple miniature copies of {{ai|Clockwork Windup|Orianna|The Ball}} can be seen on {{csl|Dr. Mundo|Corporate Mundo|possessive=true}} desk during the game's Mac Version trailer.
* In the now-removed official League of Legends [https://web.archive.org/web/20130726165848/http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/ forums], the [[File:Orianna Command- Shockwave old.png|20px|link=]] old icon of {{ai|Command: Shockwave|Orianna}} was used to represent the "Forum Games" section.
